title: Engero
description: Yiga engero za Baganda ezimanyiddwa, amakulu gaazo ne ddi lw’oziyogera.

words.target: Little by little makes a bundle.
altTarget: one by one makes a bundle
bit by bit makes a bundle
he who goes slowly goes far
the teeth that are together bite the meat

words.target: One finger can’t kill a louse.
altTarget: one finger does not kill a louse

words.target: Who hasn’t travelled thinks mother cooks best.
altTarget: he who has not travelled praises his mother’s cooking
What is the meaning of this proverb?

sentences.target: I want to know the meaning.
altTarget: I would like to know the meaning.
It means that unity is strength.

sentences.target: As they say, little by little makes a bundle.
sentences.base: Nga bwe bagamba, kamu kamu gwe muganda.
altTarget: As the saying goes, little by little makes a bundle.

sentences.target: Don’t worry. Slow and steady goes far.
altTarget: Don’t be afraid. Slow and steady goes far.

sentences.target: Let’s work together! Teeth together bite the meat.
sentences.base: Tukolere wamu! Agali awamu ge galuma ennyama.
altTarget: Let’s work together! Unity is strength.

sentences.target: Help me. One finger can’t kill a louse.
altTarget: Help me. One finger does not kill a louse.

dialogues.speaker: jjajja
options: Don’t worry. Little by little makes a bundle.

dialogues.answer: Don’t worry. Little by little makes a bundle.

guidebook.intro: Vvuunula engero za Luganda mu Lungereza, era omanye engero z’Olungereza ezifaanana nazo.

phrases.target: Little by little makes a bundle.
One finger can’t kill a louse.

tips.title: Engero ezifaanana
body: Engero nnyingi eza Luganda zirina ezifaanana nazo mu Lungereza. Bw’ovvuunula olugero, osobola okwongerako olw’Olungereza.
table: Little by little. / Rome wasn’t built in a day.
Slow and steady wins the race.

tips.title: Okuyingiza olugero
body: Okutandika olugero: **As they say, …** oba **There is a saying: …** Okunnyonnyola: **It means unity is strength.** Okubuuza: **What does this proverb mean?**

culture.title: Engero ku mikolo
body: Ku mikolo abogezi bakozesa engero nnyingi. Bw’ovvuunula mu Lungereza, nnyonnyola amakulu: **In Luganda we say “Kamu kamu gwe muganda”. It means little by little makes a bundle.**

stories.title: Amagezi ga Jjajja
stories.summary: Ssali talina bugumiikiriza ku bizinensi ye empya, ne Jjajja amuddamu n’engero.

line.speaker: ssali
line.target: Grandma, my business isn’t doing well. There are few customers.
line.base: Jjajja, bizinensi yange tekola bulungi. Abaguzi batono.

line.speaker: jjajja
line.target: Don’t worry, my child. Slow and steady goes far.
line.base: Totya, mwana wange. Akwata empola atuuka wala.

line.speaker: jjajja
line.target: It means: be patient. Little by little makes a bundle.
line.base: Kitegeeza nti, gumiikiriza. Kamu kamu gwe muganda.

line.speaker: ssali
line.target: But I work alone. I’m tired.

line.speaker: jjajja
line.target: One finger can’t kill a louse! Work with Nakato.
line.base: Olugalo olumu terutta nda! Kola ne Nakato.

steps.question: Lugero ki olugamba Ssali okukolera awamu n’abalala?
options: One finger can’t kill a louse.
Little by little makes a bundle.

line.speaker: ssali
line.target: Good idea. Teeth together bite the meat!
line.base: Kirungi. Agali awamu ge galuma ennyama!

line.speaker: jjajja
line.target: Haha! Now you speak like a grandparent!
